title: Not As Good As I Thought
text: Not As Good As I Thought. I was expecting a fuller fluffier comforter for some reason and this is really flat and silky so not my favorite.

product_metadata.title: Bedsure Twin/Twin XL Comforter Set - Grey Comforter Twin Extra Long, Soft Bedding for All Seasons, Cationic Dyed Bedding Set, 2 Pieces, 1 Comforter (68"x88") and 1 Pillow Sham (20"x26"+2")
features: Extra Soft: Bedsure's unique brushing method produces a soft, lightweight comforter perfect for summer use. The breathable microfiber filling ensures a cozy, cloud-like experience during warm nights.
Exquisite and Simplistic Style: This comforter is cationic dyed to achieve a subtle yet elegant dual color noise effect, and can easily coordinate with various home decor styles.
Comforter Duvet Insert: With four corner loops at each of the corners, this bedding set can be used as an all-season comforter or as a cozy-year-round duvet insert, whichever you prefer.
Easy to Maintain: The Bedsure Cationic Dyed Comforter Set is easy to maintain. Simply machine wash in cold water on a gentle cycle for a like-new restoration.
What You Can Get: This twin size comforter set comes with a comforter (68" x 88") and one pillow sham (20" x 26" + 2”).
